value.title: Agent Carter S2#7
value.text: Joseph Manfredi helps Whitney Frost kidnap Jason Wilkes from Howard Stark's estate, while his men briefly capture Edwin Jarvis and Peggy Carter.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Whitney's mob boss, whose men capture Jarvis while he takes Wilkes.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Peggy's ally, whom Manfredi's men capture.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#8
split.text: After Jarvis shoots Whitney, Manfredi nearly has him shot, until Whitney orders him to keep her enemies alive.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Whitney's mob boss, who nearly has Jarvis shot.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Peggy's ally, whom Manfredi nearly has shot for shooting Whitney.

verdicts.why: S2#7 is right (Manfredi's men capture Jarvis and Peggy, then he and Frost take Wilkes; S2#8 has the near-shooting), but Frost, not Manfredi's men, lures Peggy and Jarvis by reactivating Dottie's tracker, so 'his men lure' is dropped.
Dooley only watches Jarvis's S1#3 questioning from behind the glass; he first presses Jarvis himself about Finow in S1#5, and the vest is S1#7.
In S2#3 Howard's spray makes the invisible Wilkes visible, they work on a cure and Wilkes stays at the estate; the rift machine built from Frost's plans is S2#10.
Fennhoff reveals his Finow grudge to Howard and hypnotizes him to gas New York in S1#8; they never deal with each other before.
Howard and Manfredi first meet on screen in S2#10, when Manfredi walks in holding Jarvis at gunpoint and they turn out to be old friends.
Dooley briefs the SSR on Stark's disappearance and possible treason and calls him a fugitive in S1#1; he blames Stark for Krzeminski's death in S1#3.
In S1#4 Dooley questions Mueller about Finow and Thompson tells him Stark is on a flight manifest out of Finow the day after; Fennhoff causes Dooley's death in S1#7.

Howard left for Peru in S2#3 and comes back in S2#10, where Jarvis drives the car, with Howard in it, into Frost as she chases the team from the waste facility; that is the start of the episode, not the final fight.
Thompson's team brings Ivchenko back from the Red Room in S1#5; Fennhoff knocks Thompson out at Stark's warehouse in S1#8.
In S1#1 Krzeminski and Thompson are both on the Spider Raymond case and go into La Martinique; Krzeminski is murdered in S1#3.
The kidnapping and the 'never seen a black scientist' remark are S2#7; Manfredi sets up the waste facility where Frost straps Wilkes down in S2#9.
The laryngotomies on Brannis and Demidov are revealed in S1#8 (Valediction), and Fennhoff is only shown as their Leviathan contact there.
Same as Brannis: the throat surgery and Fennhoff's link to Demidov are revealed in S1#8.
Peggy frees Ivchenko from the Red Room in S1#5; his Midnight Oil plan is stopped in S1#8.
In S1#6 Ivchenko hypnotizes Dooley in his office until Sousa breaks the trance; the vest and Dooley's death are S1#7.
Manfredi first appears in S2#5, giving Frost men for the bomb job, and Peggy fights those men at the Roxxon warehouse; his men take Peggy and Jarvis prisoner in the desert in S2#8.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#2
value.text: Rufus Hunt, a hired killer sent after Jason Wilkes, attacks Wilkes and Peggy Carter, and she fights him at Isodyne Energy.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A hired killer who attacks Peggy while hunting Wilkes.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who fights Hunt while he hunts Wilkes.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#3
split.text: Hunt is then sent to kill Peggy and attacks her at Howard Stark's estate, but she shoots his hand and drives him off.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An assassin sent to kill Peggy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hunt's target, who shoots his hand and drives him off.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#4
split.text: Peggy and Jarvis capture Hunt, and she interrogates him with Daniel Sousa.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An assassin sent to kill Peggy, whom she captures and interrogates.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hunt's target, who captures him with Jarvis and interrogates him.

verdicts.why: Peggy first fights Hunt in S2#2, when he attacks her and Wilkes at the observatory and again at Isodyne, so the stage starts there. The S2#3 estate attack and the S2#4 capture follow as later stages.
Demidov kills Colleen and Peggy fights him off (burning his hand on the stove) in S1#1; the milk truck fight where he dies is S1#2.
Masters first deals with Peggy in S2#4, when he walks into the Auerbach Agency with FBI agents and an executive order and warns her that her friends could drown.

value.title: Agent Carter S1#1
value.text: Roger Dooley is Ray Krzeminski's chief at the SSR and leads him and the other agents on the Spider Raymond case.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Krzeminski's SSR chief, who leads him on the Spider Raymond case.
value.on_b_card_about_a: One of Dooley's agents, on the Spider Raymond case.

split.title: Agent Carter S1#3
split.text: When Krzeminski is murdered, Dooley blames Howard Stark and redoubles the hunt for him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Krzeminski's SSR chief, who blames his murder on Howard Stark.
split.on_b_card_about_a: One of Dooley's agents, whose murder he blames on Howard Stark.

verdicts.why: S1#1 is right (Dooley briefs Krzeminski on the Stark case and okays the La Martinique raid), but Dooley does not go into La Martinique himself; the raid is Thompson's, with Krzeminski and Yauch. That detail is dropped.
In S2#3 Chadwick calls Hunt to kill Peggy at Frost's request; Hunt threatens them and Frost absorbs him in S2#4.

value.title: Agent Carter S1#7
value.text: Posing as the Russian doctor Ivchenko, Johann Fennhoff takes over Chief Dooley's mind and has him lock Jarvis and Peggy in a room.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A mind controller who has Jarvis locked up.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Howard Stark's butler, whom Fennhoff has locked up.

split.title: Agent Carter S1#8
split.text: Fennhoff later kidnaps Howard Stark from Jarvis's side, and Jarvis takes to the air to stop the hypnotized Howard.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A mind controller who kidnaps Howard and has Jarvis locked up.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Howard Stark's butler. Takes to the air to stop Fennhoff's plan.

verdicts.why: S1#7 is right for the locked room, but Howard's kidnapping and Jarvis's flight are S1#8, so those facts move to a new S1#8 stage.
Howard tells Flynn that Carter will co-head (run with him) the new S.H.I.E.L.D., not head it.
In S4#9 Mack warns of a robot rebellion when Mace orders Aida wiped, then beheads her with the Shotgun-Ax; she swaps him for an LMD and plugs him into the Framework in S4#14.
In S4#8 Aida opens the portal under Morrow's demon core while Quake absorbs the quakes; the Framework trap and Daisy's entry are S4#14-15.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#9
value.text: When Aida turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. and attacks the Playground, Yo-Yo fights her alongside Mack until he beheads her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who fights Aida with Mack at the Playground.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The android Yo-Yo fights at the Playground.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
split.text: Yo-Yo goes into the Framework to bring Mack home, and Aida starts deleting it while the two are still inside, threatening to kill them both.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Aida threatens in the Framework.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The android who starts deleting the Framework with Yo-Yo and Mack inside.

verdicts.why: The S4#9 fight is right, but Yo-Yo only enters the Framework at the end of S4#21 and Aida starts deleting it in S4#22, so the later stage, which describes the deletion, goes on S4#22.
Radcliffe gives his AI assistant Aida a body for her 'birthday' at the end of S3#22.
Aida works with Radcliffe until S4#15, where she cuts his wrists, kills his body and leaves his mind in the Framework; the S4#9 attack was programmed by Radcliffe.
Mace greets Aida and Radcliffe at the Playground in S4#7 and agrees to use her against Morrow in S4#8. Aida interrogates the captive Mace with the Superior and replaces him with an LMD in S4#14.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#4
value.text: Jemma Simmons sees at once that Holden Radcliffe's assistant Aida is an android, and Fitz talks her into keeping it from Director Mace.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist who sees at once that Aida is an android.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android assistant, whom Jemma sees through at once.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#10
split.text: After Aida goes rogue, Jemma wants her severed head destroyed and asks Fitz to stop studying it.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist who distrusts Aida and wants her head destroyed.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, whom Jemma distrusts once she goes rogue.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#15
split.text: Aida traps Jemma's friends inside the Framework, and Jemma goes in with Daisy to free them.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist who distrusts Aida and goes into the Framework to free her friends.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who traps Jemma's friends in the Framework.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
split.text: Back in the real world, Jemma fights the newly human Aida.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist who distrusts Aida and fights her once Aida is human.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, whom Jemma rightly distrusts from the start.

verdicts.why: Jemma first meets Aida in S4#4, but there she only works out that Aida is an android and keeps it secret; she shows no distrust and later works alongside her. So the enemy text is split out: she wants the head destroyed in S4#10, enters the Framework in S4#15 and fights the human Aida from S4#21.
Coulson first meets Aida, introduced as Radcliffe's assistant, when he collects May in S4#4.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
value.text: When the newly human Aida attacks Fitz at the Playground, Piper helps pull him out of her chamber and shoots her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent on May's strike team who shoots Aida and helps Fitz escape her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The newly human android Piper shoots while rescuing Fitz.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
split.text: Coulson trusts Piper to tell the world about Aida if he fails to stop her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who shoots Aida and whom Coulson trusts to expose her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The android Piper shoots, and whom Coulson trusts Piper to expose.

verdicts.why: In S4#15 Piper is gassed and only escapes the LMD-held Playground. She never fights the LMDs and at first suspects Jemma and Daisy. She first fights Aida in S4#21, pulling Fitz from the chamber and shooting her, and leaves with Coulson's instructions about Aida in S4#22.
Robbie comes back to the Playground through the Inter-Dimensional Gate Aida built from the Darkhold in S4#7.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#3
value.text: Aida, Holden Radcliffe's android, helps save May's life after a ghost's touch nearly kills her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who helps save May's life.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#8
split.text: Then Aida kidnaps May and replaces her with a Life Model Decoy.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Aida kidnaps and swaps for a decoy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who kidnaps and replaces May.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#11
split.text: Aida keeps May captive with her mind trapped inside the Framework.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Aida helps save, then kidnaps and swaps for a decoy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who helps save May, then kidnaps and replaces her.

verdicts.why: S4#3 (Aida's power cell restarts May's heart) and the S4#8 LMD reveal are right. But that May's mind is held in a virtual world is only revealed in S4#11, so the Framework part becomes its own S4#11 stage.
In S4#12 Radcliffe and Aida join the Superior on his submarine. In S4#21 the human Ophelia orders Ivanov to stand down to save Mack, then goes back to his submarine after Fitz rejects her.
In S4#12 Aida kills the Superior's men but spares Ivanov and Shockley; in S4#13 Shockley demands she be sent away because she disgusts him.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#1
value.text: Aida is the android Holden Radcliffe builds, and Fitz helps develop her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The engineer who helps develop Aida.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#21
split.text: Once she gains a human body, she becomes obsessed with him, and when he rejects her she turns on him and the team.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The engineer who helps develop Aida, and her obsession once she is human.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The android Fitz helps develop. Once human, she becomes obsessed with him.

verdicts.why: S4#1 is right for Fitz helping develop Aida. But although she gets her human body in S4#20, Fitz rejects her and she turns on the team in S4#21, so the later stage, which describes the rejection, goes on S4#21.
Trip first meets Simmons in S1#14 (T.A.H.I.T.I.), stays on the Bus with her to treat Skye and shows an attraction to her.
Trip only joins Coulson's team after the Hydra uprising, in S1#18 (Providence); before that he and Skye barely interact.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#14
value.text: Mack and Anne Weaver serve together in Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., and she helps explain its aims when Mack brings Lance Hunter aboard the carrier.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow agent in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow agent in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., who brings Hunter aboard.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
split.text: After Mack is hurt shielding Fitz from an explosion, Weaver asks Jemma Simmons to check his injuries.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow agent in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., who has Jemma check Mack's injuries.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow agent in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., hurt shielding Fitz.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
split.text: Mack and Weaver later work together to secure dangerous alien artifacts.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow agent in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., who has Jemma check Mack's injuries.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow agent in Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D., securing alien artifacts with Weaver.

verdicts.why: S2#14 (Weaver is there when Mack brings Hunter aboard) and the S2#15 injury check are right. But the alien artifact work happens in S2#22, so it gets its own S2#22 stage.
